map.📚 深度解析：电气系统三项检测判定（接地/防雷/等电位）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Electrical Systems (Grounding / Lightning / Equipotential)
map.电气安全自检：按接地电阻、防雷等级、等电位连接电阻三项判定: Electrical-safety self-check: judge by three items — grounding resistance, lightning-protection grade, equipotential bonding resistance
map.防雷保护：接地电阻关系泄流与反击: Lightning protection: grounding resistance relates to current drainage and back-flashover
map.逐项判定：接地电阻≤4Ω、防雷等级≤2 类、等电位连接电阻≤0.2Ω；三项均满足: Item-by-item: grounding resistance ≤ 4 Ω, lightning-protection grade ≤ Class II, equipotential bonding resistance ≤ 0.2 Ω; all three satisfied = pass. High grounding resistance gives poor drainage; high equipotential difference raises touch voltage.
map.接地电阻 3Ω（≤4 ✓）、防雷等级 2 类（≤2 ✓）、等电位 0.15Ω（≤: Grounding resistance 3 Ω (≤4 ✓), lightning grade II (≤2 ✓), equipotential 0.15 Ω (≤0.2 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If grounding resistance rises to 5 Ω it fails, insufficient drainage.
map.4Ω 为常见低压系统接地示例限值（部分场合要求≤10Ω 或≤1Ω），须按设计规范: 4 Ω is a common example limit for low-voltage system grounding (some cases require ≤10 Ω or ≤1 Ω) — set by design code and soil conditions.
map.等电位连接为何控 0.2Ω？: Why control equipotential bonding at 0.2 Ω?
map.等电位电阻小可压低故障时的接触电压、减少电击与反击；≤0.2Ω 为示例严值，须用: Low equipotential resistance suppresses touch voltage during faults and reduces shock and back-flashover; ≤0.2 Ω is an example strict value — use dedicated bonding and testing.
map.接地电阻测试需在干燥天气下进行: Grounding-resistance tests should be done in dry weather
map.防雷等级依据GB/T 50057建筑物防雷设计规范: Lightning-protection grade follows GB/T 50057 Design Code for Protection of Structures Against Lightning
